summary: Nearby Amenities feature (POST /api/ai/nearby-amenities + PropertyDetail collapsible panel) fully validated. Backend 6/6 pytest passing, frontend UX/mobile/edge-case all pass.
verified_backend: POST /api/ai/nearby-amenities {Boroko/Port Moresby/NCD/house} -> 200; 6 categories returned (all allowed keys); each item has name+distance_hint+note as strings; location_label includes 'Boroko'; disclaimer present; response ~7s.
Missing both city AND suburb -> 400 'City or suburb is required'.
No URLs / phone numbers detected in item notes (regex check on live Claude output).
Server-side sanitiser enforces allowed keys, <=4 items/category, <=6 categories, string length caps.
verified_frontend: Panel [data-testid=detail-nearby-amenities] renders below Description/Features on 6046a70a Boroko property.
Toggle [data-testid=detail-nearby-amenities-toggle] is collapsed by default (aria-expanded=false, body not in DOM).

Click toggle -> loading indicator [detail-nearby-amenities-loading] appears, then location badge 'Around Boroko, Port Moresby, National Capital District' + 6 category cards (schools, hospitals, shopping, transport, recreation, beaches) + disclaimer.
Collapse -> aria-expanded=false. Reopen -> NO loading, cached data renders immediately (component-state cache verified).
Property 26288fb9 (no suburb/city) -> panel is entirely hidden (canRun guard).
Mobile 390x844: single-column stacking (grid-cols-1 at <sm), panel width 350px inside 390 viewport - no horizontal overflow.
Blue theming: icon backgrounds use bg-[#0d50e0]/10 with #0d50e0 text; header sparkle chip matches brand.
critical_code_review_comments: Server-side sanitiser only length-caps notes; it relies on the prompt to keep URLs/phones out. If Claude ever leaks one, it will pass through. Consider a regex strip on note (URLs, digit runs >=7) as belt-and-braces. Not blocking - live Claude output was clean across two invocations.
NearbyAmenities component correctly gates fetch behind `next && !data && !loading && canRun` so re-opening after error also won't retry - user has to reload page. Minor UX nit only.
Prompt explicitly forbids markdown but code still strips ``` fences defensively - good.
